description: Year 7 lower-school diagnostic starter. Mapping references are provisional concept IDs, NOT official SCSA codes. Do not publish as certified dot-point coverage until verified.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: A student tests whether water temperature changes how quickly sugar dissolves. Which variable should the student deliberately change?
questions.explanation: The independent variable is the water temperature.

questions.subject: English
questions.stimulus: Maya checked the dark clouds and hurried to bring the washing inside.
questions.question: What can the reader reasonably infer?
questions.explanation: Dark clouds and bringing washing inside suggest concern about rain.

questions.subject: HASS
questions.question: Which source is most likely to provide a firsthand account of an event?
options: A diary written by a person who witnessed it
A fictional story about the event
questions.explanation: A witness diary is a primary source for that event.

analysisRules.unassessed: No submitted responses mapped to a verified syllabus dot point
analysisRules.insufficientEvidence: Fewer than three independently scored items for a dot point
analysisRules.developing: Below 70% across at least three items
analysisRules.mastered: At least 70% across at least three items
analysisRules.warning: Thresholds are initial design defaults, not validated mastery standards.
